text: At its meeting of February 15, 2018 the Aboriginal Affairs Committee considered a presentation from Councillor Kristyn Wong-Tam, Ward 27, Toronto Centre-Rosedale on the Indigenous Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship.

City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council endorse the Indigenous Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship and support the Indigenous District application for the Smart Cities Challenge.
